from itertools import product

# Worlds: truth assignments to the candidate assumptions.
# The explanation "不时不食 = do not eat out-of-season vegetables" is only
# coherent (non-vacuous, an actual contrast to draw) if out-of-season
# vegetables existed in Confucius's era. That's the modelling premise
# (a reading of the text, not something computation can derive).
names = ["A_demanding", "B_era_has_both", "C_we_can_choose", "D_diet_shapes_mind"]

def explanation_coherent(w):
    # needs a seasonal / out-of-season distinction to exist in his time
    return w["B_era_has_both"]

worlds = [dict(zip(names, vals)) for vals in product([True, False], repeat=4)]

results = {}
for n in names:
    # Option is a necessary assumption iff explanation can't be coherent when option is false
    counter = [w for w in worlds if not w[n] and explanation_coherent(w)]
    results[n] = (len(counter) == 0)
    print(f"{n}: necessary={results[n]}, counter-worlds where option false but explanation coherent={len(counter)}")

necessary = [n for n, v in results.items() if v]
print("Necessary assumptions:", necessary)

submitted = "B_era_has_both"
if necessary == [submitted]:
    print("CHECK PASS")
else:
    print("CHECK FAIL")
